note: The polar cold palette for World's ice biomes (docs/art/polar-palette.md). Written by art/concepts/world/polar.mjs; do not edit by hand. Ice is two tones, lit and dark, with no mid blue-grey: a mid tone was 12 to 16 from the fighters' auras, under the rule's 20. Proposals pending Legal; Tools adds the schema.

ice_sheet.note: the south: land under a warm white; slopes that face the light are lit, slopes that face away and crevasses are the slate; rock peaks through in the mountains' tone

sea_ice.note: the north: floes with a warm-white top and a slate edge, a thin rim of meltwater blue where the floe meets the sea

iceberg.note: a berg is a lit face and a slate face; the part under the waterline, seen through the water, is the only blue

polar_water.note: dark and cold, darker than the temperate sea (the sea owns mid blue): the gaps between floes are the darkest thing in the picture

haze: distant ice fades to the sky's own horizon colour, as everywhere; no polar sky key is needed, the cold comes from the ground
rule: aura against ground 20 or more, body against ground 15 or more (docs/art/dynamic-sky.md section 6), with the world-light ground tint of each key applied
